Candidates can submit the NESLET application form until January 5, 2026. The SLET 2026 exam is shceduled to be conducted on March 15, 2026. State Eligibility Test (SET), formerly known as North East State Level Eligibility Test (NESLET) is conducted by SLET Commission, Assam in offline mode for the recruitment of Assistant Lecturers at institutes/colleges/universities in the states of Assam, Arunachal Pradesh, Mizoram, Manipur, Meghalaya, Sikkim and Tripura. The Himachal Pradesh Public Service Commission released the HP SET notification on January 3, 2026. The board has activated the HP SET application form 2026 on January 3, 2026. The last date to fill out the HP SET 2026 application form is January 30, 2026 till 11:59 PM. The Himachal Pradesh Public Service Commission (Authorized Agency) conducts the State Eligibility Test (SET) for determining the Eligibility for recruitment to the post(s) of Assistant Professor(s) in universities and colleges located within the State of Himachal Pradesh. Eligible candidates can fill the application form in online mode. The admit card is issued 5 days prior to the exam date to only those candidates who fill the application form successfully.
